title: WalrusResolver — An IPNS Replacement on ENS
summary: Build a Solidity contract that lets an ENS name's owner park a Walrus blob pointer on-chain. Authorization piggybacks on the ENS registry's owner/operator model, the pointer carries both the content address and the underlying Sui Blob object id (so a permissionless keeper can extend it), and reads cost one EVM `eth_call`. Replaces a DHT round-trip with a single SLOAD.
